description: Book a consultation with the Printing Labs team: creates the Google Calendar event (with Meet link unless Phone Call), registers the meeting, and emails the requester confirm/reschedule/cancel links. The time must be one of get-meeting-slots' values for that date. Only book with the user's explicit consent and their real contact details.

email.description: Requester's email (receives the invite + manage links)

mobile.description: Phone / WhatsApp number with country code

time.description: A slot exactly as returned by get-meeting-slots, e.g. '3:30 PM'

name: book-meeting
